selkie: A selkie, a grey seal with an uncanny presence, hauled up on a rock: a sleek silver-grey seal with a broad rounded head, VERY LARGE DARK FORWARD-FACING ALMOST HUMAN EYES, long pale whiskers, smooth softly spotted hide and short fore-flippers, its shed sealskin lying folded beside it. A seal, not a person, no human body
whitehart: A white hart, a magnificent PURE WHITE STAG standing alert and still, a large powerful red deer stag with a snow-white coat, a shaggy white mane at the throat, dark eyes and a dark nose, and TOWERING MANY-POINTED BRANCHING ANTLERS spreading high above its head. Entirely white, noble and otherworldly
akhlut: An akhlut, a wolf-orca spirit striding out of the surf, a powerful heavy-shouldered wolf marked in the GLOSSY BLACK AND WHITE OF A KILLER WHALE: black over the back and head, clean white patches on the flanks and belly, a WHITE OVAL EYE PATCH above each eye, a thick wet coat, strong legs and a broad tail. A wolf wearing an orca's colours
